mainText.text: Candles can be made from beeswax, the substance bees use to build honeycombs. As a beeswax candle's string, or wick, burns, the wax melts and rises up the string. <u>The wax combines with oxygen in the air, forming carbon dioxide and water.</u> This process releases energy in the form of light and heat.

pieces.text: The underlined text tells you that when beeswax and oxygen combine, carbon dioxide and water are formed. When beeswax and oxygen react, or go through a chemical change, their atoms are rearranged to form carbon dioxide and water.
Because oxygen reacts in this chemical reaction, oxygen is a reactant.

contents.text: Once it dries, concrete is stronger and more durable than many other building materials. It is resistant to wind, water, and temperature extremes. Buildings made of concrete provide better fire resistance than those made of wood. Concrete buildings also offer excellent energy efficiency.

Today, concrete is the most widely used synthetic material on Earth. Concrete has created structures like the Hoover Dam, the Burj Khalifa, and the Sydney Opera House. It is used to build homes, commercial buildings, roads, bridges, and sidewalks.
